materialized_topology.primary_pseudobulk_rule: Pure non-targeting controls and cells with one unique non-control target gene and no non-targeting guide are aggregated separately within each deposited sample. Multiple guides to the same gene are retained with the exact guide family recorded. Mixed control-target and multi-gene calls are excluded from the single-gene endpoint.
materialized_topology.reason_independent_n_unresolved: GEO exposes five deposited objects, while the source paper reports differential-expression analysis over two Perturb-seq replicates. Culture, transduction, capture, and sequencing ancestry have not been resolved.

replicate_ancestry_evidence.author_submission_template: The template defines biological replicates as separate sample rows, technical sequencing replicates as multiple files in one row, and places five samples in rows titled Perturb-Seq replicates 1 through 5.
replicate_ancestry_evidence.extended_methods: The source methods describe one day-42 FACS and 10X capture workflow but do not state whether the five submitted samples arose from independent cultures or independent transductions.
replicate_ancestry_evidence.main_paper: Differential expression for VKORC1 was analyzed over two Perturb-seq replicates.
replicate_ancestry_evidence.sra: Each GEO sample maps to a distinct BioSample and SRA experiment. Replicates 1 and 2 each contain two runs; replicates 3 through 5 each contain four runs. The runs and lanes remain technical units nested within their sample.
replicate_ancestry_evidence.conclusion: Five author-designated replicate samples and their nested technical runs are verified. Independent culture/transduction ancestry for all five is not documented, so five biological units are not yet admitted.

model_applicability.cellot_scgen: known-target held-independent-biological-replicate or held-context only; currently blocked because independent biological replicate ancestry is unresolved
model_applicability.cpa_perturblib: seen perturbation atoms and contexts only; no valid held-combination claim is registered
model_applicability.gears_genepert_scgpt_perturbation_head: exact gene-target folds only, with exact model-vocabulary identity; runtime, checkpoint, terms, and safe-loading gates remain model-specific blockers
model_applicability.perturbation_native_baselines: independent code and synthetic contract fixture are ready; fitted outer-fold state remains blocked on dataset activation and held-target-capable feature authorities

release_and_exposure.allowed_use: development-visible raw-count topology and preprocessing only until activation gates resolve

runtime_receipt.max_rss_accounting: SLURM reported 35,652 KiB and 36,108 KiB for two tasks; MaxRSS was unavailable or zero for three tasks

task_firewalls.source_outcome_derived_tables: excluded from split construction, preprocessing, features, and pseudobulk materialization

terminal_blockers: Obtain a primary record or author clarification that states whether the five author-designated replicate samples arose from independent cultures and independent transductions, and reconcile all five with the paper's two-replicate differential-expression analysis.
Freeze a rights authority for model-input use and any aggregate redistribution.
Freeze the exact Cell Ranger reference annotation authority and activation QC without using source-derived perturbation-effect outcomes.
For unseen-target ridge or bilinear comparisons, freeze held-target-capable, outcome-independent target features before reading fold outcomes.
